usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.io/api/generate/wan-2.6/i2v with JSON body {image, prompt, resolution?, duration?, negativePrompt?, seed?, enablePromptExpansion?, multiShots?, audioUrl?}
usage.outputShape: body.jobId (job id), body.status ("pending"), body.success (true), body.type — async queued job; the finished video must be retrieved by polling a job-status endpoint (poll/result shape not documented in spec)
quirks: OVER CAP: registry price is $10.00 (paymentAccepts amount 10000000 = $10 USDC on Base eip155:8453, also offered on Solana), which exceeds the QA pay cap; nothing was paid and the endpoint was not verified.
Task summary listed a different CALL url in earlier notes (api.xona-agent.com) but the authoritative spec url is https://stablestudio.io/api/generate/wan-2.6/i2v — use the stablestudio.io url.
image-to-video model: requires a publicly reachable source image URL (image) plus a motion prompt (prompt). Both are required.
Async/queued: a paid call returns {success:true, jobId, status:'pending', type}; the actual video is retrieved by polling a job-status endpoint (poll path not documented in the spec).
Pays USDC on Base (default) or Solana; $10 flat per generation.
usage.guide: Wan 2.6 is an image-to-video generator priced at $10.00 per call, which is OVER the QA pay cap, so it was not paid or verified. To use it, POST JSON to https://stablestudio.io/api/generate/wan-2.6/i2v with a publicly reachable source image URL (image) and a motion prompt (prompt); optional resolution (720p/1080p), duration (5/10/15 seconds), negativePrompt, seed, and audioUrl. The response is an async job ({success, jobId, status:'pending', type}); poll the corresponding job-status endpoint to fetch the finished video once status completes. Pay USDC on Base (eip155:8453) or Solana.
